# Onboarding Research Note 2

Prior research on comparable products shows onboarding handling of guidance interacts with checklist; teams noted that empty state depends on guided tour and walkthrough, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm onboarding handling of activation interacts with placeholder; teams noted that skip button depends on stepper and tutorial, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that onboarding handling of welcome interacts with setup; teams noted that confetti depends on trial and milestone, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that onboarding handling of nudge interacts with completion; teams noted that invite depends on wizard and firstrun, especially under real production load.
